name: line-boil
title: Line Boil
description: A hand-drawn outline draws itself, boils on threes like a cel animation, and fills with color while it keeps boiling. Takes any closed outline as SVG path data in the path variable (default: a five-point star).
useWhen: A simple mark, icon or shape should feel hand-animated, with the restless line of traditional cel animation.
A playful explainer or kids-friendly scene needs a hero shape that draws itself and then stays alive on screen.
You have the shape as SVG path data and want it drawn, filled and boiling without keyframing anything.
avoidWhen: The thing being drawn is a word or a font's glyph outlines: use outline-trace.
The line should circle or mark up an existing part of the frame rather than be the subject: use scribble-circle.
Existing content should just feel hand-placed and jittery, without being redrawn: use paper-wobble.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Path
variables.description: Closed outline as SVG path data, in any coordinate space. It is fitted to the frame.

variables.label: Boil every
variables.description: Frames each drawing holds before the next one (3 is on threes).

variables.label: Drawings
variables.description: Distinct drawings the boil cycles through.

variables.label: Wobble
variables.description: Wobble strength; 1 is a gentle hand-drawn boil.

variables.label: Line weight
variables.description: Base line weight in pixels at 720p.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Shape size as a fraction of the short frame side.
